text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, looking greeeat! As expected of you, 
City-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Would you like to 
take another shot with a different 
pattern?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
That's right, let's keep going! Next, run 
along the water's edge with a 
swish-swish-swish!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... gh! How was that...!?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, wonderful! That's so good♪ Let's keep 
up this fiery pace! Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Finiiiish! Good work out there~☆ Look 
forward to how it turns out♪

The photographer got totally into it and 
the shoot dragged on, leaving Gold City 
completely exhausted.
